video.title: 360 Ridealong Through the Heartland at Mid-Ohio Sports Car Course | INDYCAR
video.camera: 360 deg camera on the roof of the Honda pace car; equirectangular 3840x2048 (YouTube format 313), read with inventory/equirect.py: four 100 deg views every 2 s, three views every 0.5 s
video.licence: Standard YouTube licence (reference only); downloaded under tools/track/cache (ignored), never executed
